_metadata.label: proxy -- INVENTORY_DETAILS with TOTAL_UNITS > 0. Not confirmed eShop visibility.

caveats: This is a CUMULATIVE ledger, not a live snapshot. TOTAL_UNITS > 0 is a proxy for 'items with stock' but includes historical entries that may no longer be active.
No 'published_date' or 'listed_date' column exists. AWB_SHIP_DATE is vendor ship date, not listing date.
No link to eShop visibility confirmed. INVENTORY_TYPE='M' with stock > 0 is hypothesized to be eShop-visible but not confirmed.
Hard Goods TOTAL_UNITS may use different unit semantics (inflated counts).
Bill Doran Company (2) Hard Goods shows 6.3B total_units -- likely a unit-type artifact.
